products.title: Back To The Finish by Jeff Glover
products.body:
Jeff Glover Takes You Back To The Finish As He Teaches His Favorite Back Takes, Back Controls, Traps, And Submissions!
  • Master one of the most dominant positions in Jiu-Jitsu, the back, with BJJ champ Jeff Glover!
  • Glover is widely regarded as one of the most innovative and creative Jiu-Jitsu practitioners of all time, his latest series puts that creativity to work with attacking the back.
  • Control the back like never before with Glover’s arm trap method, escape prevention, hook placement, and more!
  • Discover surprise submissions from the back that are easy-to-learn and hard-to-defend!
  • Go Back To The Finish with Jeff Glover!

Dominate From The Back With Jeff Glover’s Unique Approach To Taking, Controlling, And Attacking The Back!

 

Check out a free sample:

What Will You Learn?

The ability to outflank opponents and leave them with little defensive options is one of the most used approaches in ALL levels of Jiu-Jitsu. That said, securing the back of a skilled opponent can be quite challenging. Sometimes it will require a little creativity...THANKFULLY, Jeff Glover is here to lay out a complete game plan for taking the back, securing the position, and setting up fight-ending finishes with his 3-part series Back To The Finish!


Jeff Glover is known as one of the most creative and entertaining Jiu-Jitsu competitors of all time. His series Back To The Finish puts that creativity on full display with innovative ways to take the back from multiple positions/scenarios. Develop a mindset to attack the back by being able to find unique ways to the back including closed/open guard, side control, and of course the turtle. Not only will you be able to secure the back but do so while trapping the opponent’s arms in the process!

Throughout the three parts of the series, Glover uncovers his favorite ways to take the back, control the position, and set up submissions. Since you will have an ample amount of new tools to help you get to the back, it only makes sense to develop crippling control from this already dominating position. Glover shares his favorite ways to prevent escapes, trap arms, and keep opponents where you want them. Learn perfect hook placement to keep tabs on your opponent’s hips and leave no option of escape!

A Jeff Glover instructional wouldn’t be complete with a set of unforgettable submissions! Jeff explores the common finishes you will encounter from the back, but also goes in on some alternative finishes that will be sure to catch opponents by surprise. Make the back the last stop for the opposition with Jeff Glover’s Back To The Finish!

 

So, What Exactly Do You Get?

PART 1

  • INTRODUCTION
  • CONCEPTS OF CONTROL
  • PREVENTING THE ESCAPE
  • PREVENTING THE ESCAPE 2
  • PU EM' IN YOUR POCKET

    PART 2

  • SETTING IN HOOKS
  • SETTING IN HOOK IF TURTLES
  • GETTING BACK FROM CLOSED GUARD
  • ROLLING BACK

    PART 3

  • SIDE CONTROL
  • KIMURA TRAP
  • OPEN GUARD/ROLLING BACK TAKE
  • SIDE CONTROL CROSS FACE BACK TAKE
  • ALTERNATE FINISHES FROM THE BACK
  • OUTRO

products.title: The Foundations of Back Control by Ante Dzolic
products.body:
Build A Rock Solid Foundation For Controlling And Attacking The Back With Ante Dzolic!
  • Ante Dzolic is a BJJ black belt and full-time head instructor with multiple instructionals, this time he sets his sights on the foundations of back control!
  • Start with basic fundamental controls and advance to more sophisticated controls that will give you the edge on more experienced opponents.
  • Dive into granular details of both upper body and lower body controls that make escape your opponent’s furthest option.
  • Trap opponents in back control where every escape they attempt can lead to other forms of back control like the crucifix, the harness system, and MORE!
